name: pdf
description: Create, read, reformat, fill, transform, and validate PDF documents, including professional reports, Markdown and LaTeX rendering, form filling, OCR-assisted extraction, page operations, layout-preserving translation, and delivery quality checks.
author: MiniMax
exampleQueries: Create a polished A4 PDF report from my source materials with a cover page, table of contents, charts, headers and footers, source links, and final visual quality checks.
Read this PDF, extract its text and tables, use OCR or page-level visual inspection where needed, and return a structured summary with page references.
Fill this uploaded PDF form with the provided information while preserving its original layout, then verify that every field is visible and correctly placed.
